title: Permissions: View-only sees no pencil and gets 403 on save, no View gets 403 on the locations list
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. API replays from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logins: Admin; a user on custom role "QA PL View only"; a user on custom role "QA PL Create&Edit" (View + Create & Edit, Delete unticked); a user on a role without Part Library & Inventory View. Data: QAPL-E1 (note its entry id from /parts-catalogue/{id} and its description). DevTools open in each session.
custom_steps:
1. As Admin: Parts > Part Library (note the toolbar) > open QAPL-E1 > pencil > change the Description > Save; in Network keep the POST /api/parts-catalogue/change-catalogue-part body; then restore the description.
  2. As the View-only user: Parts > Part Library.
  3. Open QAPL-E1's entry.
  4. In the View-only user's session, replay POST /api/parts-catalogue/change-catalogue-part with the body from step 1 (that user's own session, X-Location-ID Staging Heavy Duty), then reload the entry.
  5. As the Create & Edit user: open QAPL-E1 > pencil > change the Description > Save, then restore it.
  6. As the user without Part Library & Inventory View: replay GET /api/inventory/parts/list-workplaces?catalogPart=<QAPL-E1 entry id> with X-Location-ID Staging Heavy Duty.
custom_expected:
1. Both saves return 200 and the description is restored.
  2. The toolbar is the same as Admin's (search, Manufacturer/Category chips, sort, Column Selection, row ticks and Set category); no "New catalog part".
  3. The detail page opens with no pencil: button_edit_catalogue_part is not present.
  4. 403; after the reload QAPL-E1's description is unchanged.
  5. The pencil shows; the save returns 200 and is restored.
  6. 403.
